case.description: Develop a review workflow for locating the earliest supported point of divergence between two synthetic document-processing runs. The reviewer receives bounded records, rather than access to a live system.
case.valued_outcome: For each of six paired runs, report the earliest supported divergent stage or an explicit unresolved interval, with record references and a next check that fits the supplied resources.
hard_constraints: Do not treat absent records as proof that a stage did not execute.
Spend at most twelve manual record inspections per paired run.
Every definite stage claim must cite a supplied record.
resources: Six paired synthetic runs, each with twelve records across ingest, parse, transform and export.
Each record supplies a stage, local timestamp, input digest, output digest and optional warning; twelve warning fields are blank.
One manifest containing expected stage order and record identifiers, and a dictionary defining each field.
A spreadsheet or local script environment and sixty minutes of analyst time.
observations: Four pairs share their ingest output digest.
Two pairs have export mismatches but missing transform output digests.
Awkward observation: one export record has a timestamp earlier than its parse record, although their identifiers follow the supplied stage order.
